
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yudanqu/p/22456248" title="发布于 2026-08-13 22:42">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">100行Python代码，搭一个能干活的AI Agent</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4ls0" style="font-size: 15px">跟大模型聊天人人都会，但你有没有想过——为什么ChatGPT能帮你订餐、查航班、写代码，而你调用API只会一问一答？</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4wpd" style="font-size: 15px"><span leaf="">差别就两个字：</span><strong><span leaf="">Agent</span></strong><span leaf="">。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4u6m" style="font-size: 15px">大模型是大脑，但没手没脚没记忆。你问它"北京天气怎么样"，它只会说"我无法访问实时数据"。Agent就是给大脑装上四肢、记忆和执行力——让它自己判断该用什么工具，执行完再思考下一步。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4ebu" style="font-size: 15px">听起来很复杂？其实核心就一个公式：</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41y9c" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">Agent =&nbsp;</span></strong><strong><span leaf="">LLM</span></strong><strong><span leaf="">（大脑）+ Tools（双手）+ Memory（记忆）+ Loop（循环）</span></strong></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4k38" style="font-size: 15px">今天用100行Python代码，把这四个模块从零搭一遍。不依赖任何框架，跑完你就明白Agent到底是怎么回事。</span></p><section mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section mpa-data-temp-power-by="yiban.io" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="width: 100%; &nbsp; memory = Memory()</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 52px; width: 263px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"你是一个有用的助手，可以调用工具回答问题。"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"user"</span></span><span leaf="">, user_input)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">for</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;step&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">in</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;range(max_steps):</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 174px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"\n--- 第</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 65px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{step +&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(209, 154, 102, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">1</span></span><span leaf="">}</span></span><span leaf="">步 ---"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; response = ask_llm(memory.get_messages(), tools=TOOLS)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">if</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">not</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.tool_calls:</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 206px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"Agent回答：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 118px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{response.content}</span></span><span leaf="">"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">return</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.content</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 72px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"assistant"</span></span><span leaf="">, response.content&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">or</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">""</span></span><span leaf="">, tool_calls=response.tool_calls)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">for</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;tool_call&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">in</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.tool_calls:</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; name = tool_call.function.name</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 171px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"调用工具：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{name}</span></span><span leaf="">(</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{args}</span></span><span leaf="">)"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; result = TOOL_MAP[name](**args)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 131px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"工具返回：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 52px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{result}</span></span><span leaf="">"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"tool"</span></span><span leaf="">, result, tool_call_id=tool_call.id)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">return</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 153px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"达到最大步数，Agent停止"</span></span></code></pre></section><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx417qk" style="font-size: 15px">拆解这个循环：</span></p><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1"><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4c0e" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">思考</span></strong><span leaf="">：把对话历史和工具列表发给LLM，LLM决定下一步干什么</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx421ov" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">判断</span></strong><span leaf="">：如果LLM没有请求调用工具，说明它觉得可以直接回答了，循环结束</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx423np" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">行动</span></strong><span leaf="">：LLM说"我要查北京天气"，你的代码就执行</span><code><span leaf="">get_weather("北京")</span></code></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4y3y" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">观察</span></strong><span leaf="">：把工具执行结果塞回messages，让LLM看到结果</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41ma0" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">重复</span></strong><span leaf="">：LLM拿到结果后再思考，可能还需要调别的工具，也可能可以直接回答了</span></span></p></li></ol><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4ey5" style="font-size: 15px"><code><span leaf="">max_steps</span></code><span leaf="">是安全阀，防止Agent陷入死循环。实际使用中10步足够处理大部分任务。</span></span></p><h2 style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41fuz" style="font-size: 15px">跑起来看效果</span></h2><section mpa-preserve="t" mpa-from-tpl="t"><pre style="margin: 0; white-space: nowrap" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4237c"><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 103px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz43abf19kf" style="font-size: 13px"># 测试1：简单计算</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span mpa-font-style="mrz43abf8wm" style="font-size: 13px"><span leaf="">run_agent(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 177px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"帮我算一下 123 * 456 + 789"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span></span></code></pre></section><p><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4cax" style="font-size: 15px">输出：</span></p><section style="text-align: center" nodeleaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813224124046-697612576.png" alt=""></section><p><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41jc7" style="font-size: 15px">两步完成：第一步调计算器，第二步直接回答。</span></p><section mpa-preserve="t" mpa-from-tpl="t"><pre style="margin: 0; white-space: nowrap" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4rpw"><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 115px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz431irn95" style="font-size: 13px"># 测试2：多步骤任务</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span mpa-font-style="mrz431ir2509" style="font-size: 13px"><span leaf="">run_agent(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 192px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"北京和上海哪个温度高？并帮我算一下高多少？</span><span leaf="">"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span></span></code></pre></section><p><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx42ie" style="font-size: 15px">输出：</span></p><section style="text-align: center" nodeleaf=""><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1279674/202608/1279674-20260813224124557-2092965632.png" alt=""></section><section mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section mpa-data-temp-power-by="yiban.io" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px 10px" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="display: grid; justify-content: flex-start; align-items: flex-end; flex-direction: column; grid-template-columns: 100% 100%" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 1) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 1) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 1) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 1) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 1) 100%); border-radius: 19px; padding-bottom: 1.5px; z-index: 1" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="background: rgba(18, 18, 20, 1); border-radius: 19px; text-align: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 8px 17px 8px 25px" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="text-align: center" mpa-from-tpl="t"><p style="font-weight: bold; font-size: 17px; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); line-height: 24px"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41jrf" style="font-size: 15px">Silas说</span><span leaf=""><br></span></p></section><section style="margin-left: 12px; width: 10px; height: 10px; transform: rotate(45deg); border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); flex-shrink: 0" mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section></section></section><section style="width: 100%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(224, 93, 76, 0.48) 0, rgba(255, 226, 121, 0.48) 22%, rgba(167, 255, 117, 0.48) 45%, rgba(88, 238, 234, 0.48) 69%, rgba(57, 169, 241, 0.48) 100%); -webkit-filter: blur(6px); transform: translateX(-100.1%) scale(1.02); border-radius: 24px; margin-bottom: -6px" mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section></section></section></section><h2><span leaf=""><br></span></h2><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4dfv" style="font-size: 15px"><span leaf="">写完这100行代码，最大的感受是：</span><strong><span leaf="">Agent一点都不神秘</span></strong><span leaf="">。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41lg4" style="font-size: 15px">网上铺天盖地的Agent框架——LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI——把这件事包装得很复杂。但你把核心扒开看，就是一个while循环：LLM决定调什么工具，你的代码执行，结果传回去，循环直到完成。框架做的事，无非是帮你把这个循环封装好，再加上一些工程化的东西（重试、超时、日志）。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx44y3" style="font-size: 15px"><span leaf="">我的建议：</span><strong><span leaf="">先手写一遍，再用框架</span></strong><span leaf="">。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4231p" style="font-size: 15px"><span leaf="">不是框架不好，是你不理解原理直接用框架，出了问题完全不知道怎么排查。你不知道</span><code><span leaf="">tool_calls</span></code><span leaf="">的格式长什么样，不知道messages里每条消息的role有什么讲究，调试的时候就是两眼一抹黑。</span></span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4fgq" style="font-size: 15px">还有一点：别急着给Agent加复杂的Planning和Multi-Agent协作。先把这个最小闭环跑通，加一个你自己业务场景需要的工具（比如查数据库、调内部API），让它真正干一件有用的事。能稳定跑一周，再考虑扩展。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41c7o" style="font-size: 15px">Agent的价值不在于架构多精巧，在于它能不能稳定地把一件事干好。</span></p><hr style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-right: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-bottom: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); border-left: 0 solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1); -webkit-transform-origin: 0 0; -webkit-transform: scale(1, 0.5); transform-origin: left top; transform: scale(1, 0.5)"><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx45ab" style="font-size: 15px">跑通代码后，可以试试这些扩展方向：</span></p><ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1"><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41h21" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">换个工具</span></strong><span leaf="">：把</span><code><span leaf="">get_weather</span></code><span leaf="">换成查数据库、调内部API、发邮件——只要是个Python函数就能当工具</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41on8" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">加RAG</span></strong><span leaf="">：给Agent接一个知识库，让它能查文档回答问题</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx4v6b" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">多Agent协作</span></strong><span leaf="">：多个Agent分工合作，比如一个负责搜索、一个负责写作</span></span></p></li><li><p style="text-align: left"><span mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx45qe" style="font-size: 15px"><strong><span leaf="">试试框架</span></strong><span leaf="">：理解原理后再用LangChain或CrewAI，你会发现它们其实就是帮你封装了这套循环</span></span></p></li></ol><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41tqs" style="font-size: 15px">完整代码我已经整理好了，复制就能跑。你给Agent加了什么有意思的工具？评论区聊聊。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41jg4" style="font-size: 15px">觉得有用的话，转给也在折腾AI的朋友。</span></p><p style="text-align: left"><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx41j7z" style="font-size: 15px">关注我，持续分享AI实操和踩坑记录。</span></p><section><span></span></section><h2><span leaf="" mpa-font-style="mrz3ycx45wj" style="font-size: 15px"><span textstyle="" style="font-weight: bold">&lt;完整代码&gt;</span></span></h2><section mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section mpa-preserve="t" mpa-from-tpl="t"><pre style="margin: 0; padding: 0; background: none"><code style="border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.85em; margin: 0 0.15em; background: rgba(40, 44, 52, 1); color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); display: block; padding: 5.95px; overflow-x: auto; white-space: nowrap"><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 229px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"""</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">最小AI Agent实现 —— 100行代码搞定</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">Agent = LLM + Tools + Memory + Loop</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">"""</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 26px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">from</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;openai&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">import</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;OpenAI</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">import</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;json</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 26px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">from</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;dotenv&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">import</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;load_dotenv</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">import</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;os</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">load_dotenv()</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 287px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># ============ 1. LLM调用（大脑）============</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">client = OpenAI(</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 335px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># api_key="your-api-key", # 换成你的DeepSeek API Key</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; api_key=os.getenv(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 118px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"</span></span><span leaf="">),&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 155px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># 或使用env方式存储apikey</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; base_url=</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 170px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"https://api.deepseek.com"</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(171, 178, 191, 1); width: 263px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"你是一个有用的助手，可以调用工具回答问题。"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"user"</span></span><span leaf="">, user_input)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">for</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;step&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">in</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;range(max_steps):</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 174px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"\n--- 第</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 65px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{step +&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(209, 154, 102, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 7px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">1</span></span><span leaf="">}</span></span><span leaf="">步 ---"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; response = ask_llm(memory.get_messages(), tools=TOOLS)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">if</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">not</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.tool_calls:</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 206px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"Agent回答：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 118px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{response.content}</span></span><span leaf="">"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">return</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.content</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 72px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"assistant"</span></span><span leaf="">, response.content&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">or</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">""</span></span><span leaf="">, tool_calls=response.tool_calls)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 20px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">for</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;tool_call&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">in</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;response.tool_calls:</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; name = tool_call.function.name</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; args = json.loads(tool_call.function.arguments)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 171px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"调用工具：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{name}</span></span><span leaf="">(</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{args}</span></span><span leaf="">)"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; result = TOOL_MAP[name](**args)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; print(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 131px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">f"工具返回：</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 108, 117, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 52px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">{result}</span></span><span leaf="">"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; memory.add(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"tool"</span></span><span leaf="">, result, tool_call_id=tool_call.id)</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 39px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">return</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 153px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"达到最大步数，Agent停止"</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(92, 99, 112, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 227px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic"><span leaf=""># ============ 5. 测试 ============</span></span><span leaf=""><br></span><span style="color: rgba(198, 120, 221, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 13px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">if</span></span><span leaf="">&nbsp;__name__ ==&nbsp;</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 65px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"__main__"</span></span><span leaf="">:</span><span leaf=""><br></span><span leaf="">&nbsp; &nbsp; run_agent(</span><span style="color: rgba(152, 195, 121, 1); background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: inline; width: 263px; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal"><span leaf="">"北京和上海哪个温度高？并帮我算一下高多少？"</span></span><span leaf="">)</span></code></pre></section><section mpa-from-tpl="t"><span leaf=""><br></span></section><section mpa-data-temp-power-by="yiban.io" mpa-from-tpl="t"><section mpa-from-tpl="t"><section style="display: flex;
